conventions.clock: Each step has an at time; the Site under test uses it as the current time for that step.
conventions.callers: A dot step names the platform user id the identity header carries. A nash step names the device and generation its session resolves to; a serviceOnly step sends only OAI-Sites-Authorization; a refresh step names in deviceCredential the value it sends in the Nash-Device-Credential header. Session tokens and device credentials appear only in pairing vectors, as obviously fake generated values.
conventions.generated: The Site generates itemId and leaseNonce values, and in pairing vectors the values under generated.pairing. A test harness injects them in the listed order, so expected outputs are exact.
conventions.expectations: A step expects either result, the exact response body or structuredContent, or error, the exact error body. A tool error is an MCP result with isError true and the error body as structuredContent.
conventions.paths: An endpoint step with itemId fills the {itemId} path parameter of the endpoint.

vectors.description: After a restart NASH has no session; it presents its device credential in the Nash-Device-Credential header and gets a new session and a rotated credential without asking the owner.
